name: Amaterasu
passives: Spirit Seal: Amaterion gains Sealfire when defender play anchors a control zone and converts enemy commitment into mitigation on shrine threshold ground. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a purification and boundary law rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of Sacred Kingdoms.
lore: Amaterasu, Sun Mirror Empress, is now canonized as one of the four playable deities of Kami. The deity is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: sun kami, imperial mirror, sacred light, sovereign shrine protection. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology deity whose behavior expresses sun kami, imperial mirror, sacred light, sovereign shrine protection; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Kami canon.
visualDescription: Amaterasu manifests as sun kami, imperial mirror, sacred light, sovereign shrine protection from Kami: beautiful feminine imperial Japanese face, luminous eyes, delicate nose, calm red-lacquered lips; elegant feminine empress frame, graceful neck, narrow waist, layered kimono-armor preserving feminine silhouette; signature silhouette: mirror aura, long sleeve-armor panels, sun hair ornaments, shrine-empress profile. Weapon: mirror-disc shield and radiant ceremonial blade. Maintain the approved Mythos Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Amaterion — Kagura Spirit Cut Anchor
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Kami source-culture damage at range 2; generate Momentum and a small Shrine Resonance gain when used from torii-marked sacred threshold or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as torii silhouettes, shimenawa cords, white shide seals, mirror silver, foxfire blue, cedar lacquer, tengu wind, oni iron, dragon rain.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Shide Seal Technique — Bastion
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to protects a control zone, redirects enemy intent, and turns correct positioning into mitigation. Builds Shrine Resonance only when the player uses torii-marked sacred threshold intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Amaterion: Torii Boundary Rewrite Holdfast
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Shrine Resonance to impose a two-round rule from Sacred Kingdoms: protects a control zone, redirects enemy intent, and turns correct positioning into mitigation. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Amaterasu Moon-Gate Radiance
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Shrine Resonance, transform nearby terrain into torii-marked sacred threshold, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Amaterion Bulwark Mirror-Talisman Spirit Blade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through torii-marked sacred threshold. Visual: torii silhouettes, shimenawa cords, white shide seals, mirror silver, foxfire blue, cedar lacquer, tengu wind, oni iron, dragon rain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Amaterion Lacquered Shimenawa Spirit-Guard
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Sacred Kingdoms source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the player followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Amaterion Kitsune Foxfire Magatama Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Shrine Resonance and unlocks a mastery branch for Torii Moonstep, Kitsune Misdirection Counter, and Purify the Trespass. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Amaterion's Spirit Seal: a solo mechanic where Sealfire grows through shrine threshold ground, reaction-window mastery, and defender decisions that anchor a control zone and convert enemy commitment into mitigation. Payoff: hold objectives longer while redirecting the next revealed enemy intent. Counterplay: spread attackers, displacement, or terrain denial break the anchor; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: spread attackers, displacement, or terrain denial break the anchor
